note: South Korea, read on 2026-10-31 in the Enforcement Decree of the Immigration Act as the Korea Legislation Research Institute's English statute service gives it (elaw.klri.re.kr, the version of Presidential Decree No. 28211 of 26 July 2017; KLRI's translation, secondary to the Korean text on law.go.kr, which this client can't read past a script shell). Article 23 (Employment and Status of Stay of Aliens): no holder of Permanent Resident (F-5) status is subject to restrictions on activities by the classification of status of stay, and no Marriage Migrant (F-6) holder to restrictions on job-seeking activities (both written as work: any). The statuses that allow employment within their classification run from Professor (E-1) to Foreign National of Special Ability (E-7), which includes the Arts and Entertainment (E-6) status, but its name, its longest sojourn period and its terms are in Appendix 1, which KLRI's page doesn't hold, so it isn't written. No fee, decision time, term, renewal or years to permanent residence are written: the fees are the Enforcement Rules' (article 71), not read, and the Act's article 10-3 wasn't read. Amendments to the Decree after July 2017 weren't read.

sources.title: Korea Legislation Research Institute: Enforcement Decree of the Immigration Act (Presidential Decree No. 28211, Jul. 26, 2017), English translation
sources.said: Article 23 (Employment and Status of Stay of Aliens) ... (1) Status of stay that entitles an alien to engage in job-seeking activities under Article 18 (1) of the Act shall be such status of stay as 9. Short-Term Employee (C-4), 19. Professor (E-1) through 25. Foreign National of Special Ability (E-7) ... none of the following persons shall be subject to restrictions on job-seeking activities based on the classification of status of stay specified in Appendix 1: ... 3. A person holding the status of stay of 28-4. Marriage Migrant (F-6) in Appendix 1. ... (4) Notwithstanding paragraph (1), no person holding the status of stay of 28-3. Permanent Resident (F-5) in Appendix 1 shall be subject to restrictions on activities based on the classification of status of stay as specified in Appendix 1. ... Presidential Decree No. 28211, Jul. 26, 2017
